verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI supports agentic coding, automation (non-interactive scripting, GitHub Actions PR review/issue triage, @gemini-cli mentions), and can build/debug/demo code end-to-end, but this is a local/CI-triggered agent rather than a persistent cloud agent, and multiple community reports describe it getting stuck in loops, failing simple agentic tasks, and even destructively deleting files, undermining reliable autonomous build-test-demo workflows.
